{{Top|leg}}
The '''Ahto University''' was a [[University/Legends|university]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]]. The university shared its name with Manaan's [[Capital/Legends|capital]], [[Ahto City/Legends|Ahto City]]. [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Narlan Syphus]] was one of the [[Professor/Legends|professors]] in the university.<ref name="Selkath Isolationists">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=codex|Selkath Isolationists: The Syphus Collective}}</ref>

{{Edu-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Ahto University was first mentioned in the codex entry "Selkath Isolationists: The Syphus Collective," introduced in Game Update 7.1: ''Digging Deeper'', released on [[August 2]], [[2022]], as part of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'',<ref name="TORweb">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20220802|text=Game Update 7.1 "Digging Deeper" is live!}}</ref> the eighth digital expansion to the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Announcement">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20210701|text=Announcing Legacy of the Sith, the next expansion for Star Wars: The Old Republic}}</ref>
